name: Malachi
summary: A prophet through whom the LORD sent His word to Israel. The LORD answered the people's doubting questions and promised to send His messenger before Him.

key_moments.title: I Have Loved You
key_moments.description: Through Malachi the LORD told Israel He loved them. When they asked how, He pointed to how He had loved Jacob rather than his brother Esau.

key_moments.title: My Messenger Will Come
key_moments.description: The LORD promised to send His messenger to prepare the way, and then the Lord would suddenly come to His temple and purify His people like silver and gold.

key_moments.title: Bring the Tithes
key_moments.description: The LORD said the people had robbed Him by holding back tithes and offerings. He told them to bring all the tithes and test Him, and He would pour out a blessing.

key_moments.title: Elijah Will Be Sent
key_moments.description: The LORD told them to remember the law He gave through Moses, and promised to send Elijah the prophet before His great day, to turn the hearts of fathers and children to each other.
